label: HAP equals the lower of PS minus TTP or gross rent minus TTP
notes: Housing assistance payment is max(0, min(payment_standard - TTP, gross_rent - TTP)). Payment standard is the maximum monthly subsidy before TTP.

label: family payment standard is the lower of voucher size or unit size
notes: Use the lower of the payment standard for family unit size (PHA subsidy standard / voucher bedrooms) and the payment standard for the dwelling unit rented.

label: gross rent is rent to owner plus utility allowance
notes: Gross rent = rent to owner + utility allowance. Tenant-paid utilities are those not included in rent to owner.

label: utility reimbursement is HAP above rent to owner
notes: If HAP exceeds rent to owner, the excess is a utility reimbursement to the family.

label: in-place PS decrease not earlier than two years
notes: PHA may choose not to reduce the family's PS while they stay in the unit. If the Admin Plan reduces it, the first cut may not apply earlier than two years after the schedule decrease, and only after 12 months' written notice.

label: in-place PS increase by the earliest of three dates
notes: Must apply the higher PS no later than the earliest of: (i) a gross-rent increase that would raise family share; (ii) the family's first regular or interim reexamination; or (iii) one year after the PS increase. PHA may apply earlier (c)(5).

label: TTP planning proxy is 30 percent of monthly adjusted income
notes: Full TTP is the highest of 30% monthly adjusted income, 10% monthly income, welfare housing designation, or minimum rent (5.630). The desk's --mai flag uses only the 30% prong as a planning input — pass --ttp when you already have TTP.
